rule: Route requests about Zoom Webinar licensing, setup, or capacity to lms-canvas.
Route inquiries about setting up off-campus VPN access to library databases to telecom-network.
Route desk phone line outages, dial tone issues, and office phone connection requests to telecom-network.
Route missing Zoom cloud recording retrieval questions to lms-canvas.
Route missing student roster synchronizations between Banner and Canvas to registrar-systems.
Route device network registration issues in residence halls such as Aspen, Cedar Commons, and Elmhurst to resnet.
Route requests for accounts and access on the Granite cluster to research-computing.
Route biology or academic course evaluation loading issues to research-computing.
Route lecture capture and Panopto recording issues in classrooms to classroom-av.
Route multi-factor authentication issues for new mobile phones accessing Canvas to identity-access.
Route password resets and account existence errors to identity-access.
Route dead ethernet jack reports in residence halls to resnet.
Route missing lecture recording inquiries for specific room locations to classroom-av.
Route vague troubleshooting requests without specific details to service-desk.
Route questions regarding the FAFSA school code for NSU to financial-aid-systems.
Route game console network registration issues in student residence rooms to resnet.
Route Wi-Fi outage reports in campus public spaces like the Whitlock Student Union to telecom-network.
Route grade syncing issues between Canvas gradebooks and Banner rosters to registrar-systems.
Route podium computer and projector display failures in classrooms to classroom-av.
Route desk phone hardware indicator and voicemail light issues to telecom-network.
